# Compactor Full Technical Specification for AI Agents

> Author: Kuber Bassi (https://kuberbassi.com)
> Application URL: https://compactor.kuberbassi.com

Compactor is a client-side WebApplication built with React 19, WebAssembly (@ffmpeg/ffmpeg), pdf-lib, and HTML5 Canvas API.

## Architecture
- 100% In-Browser Execution: Zero server data uploads. Files processed in browser memory.
- Multithreading: Uses SharedArrayBuffer with Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy (COOP) and Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy (COEP) headers.

## Full Tool Catalog

### 1. Video Processing Suite (#video-compressor)
- Mode: Video Compression, Video to Audio, Video to GIF, Mute Video.
- Size Clamp Presets: Discord Free (<=10 MB), WhatsApp (<=16 MB), TikTok (<=70 MB), Instagram (<=95 MB).
- Custom CRF Range: 18 (visually lossless) to 40 (high compression).
- Formats Supported: MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV, AVI, FLV.

### 2. PDF Studio Suite (#pdf-organize)
- Page Management: Drag-and-drop page reordering, extraction, rotation, page deletion.
- Document Filters:
  - Smart Magic Color: Removes paper shadows, whitens background (lum > 150), darkens text ink.
  - Whiteboard Clean: Removes room glare & shadows, forces whiteboard to pure #ffffff white.
  - B&W Binary Scan: Dynamic binarization thresholding for 1-bit crisp document pages.
  - Vibrant Diagram: High-contrast diagram and chart color boost.
- Security: AES-128/256 password encryption and unlock decryption.
- Signature & Stamps: Vector approval stamps (APPROVED, CONFIDENTIAL, FINAL DRAFT) and custom signature titles.
- Page Numbers & Crop: Header/footer numbering and trim margin percentages.

### 3. Image Optimizer (#image-optimizer)
- Compression: Quality sliders for PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, AVIF formats.
- Transformations: Aspect ratio crop (1:1, 16:9, 4:3, 9:16), rotation, horizontal/vertical flipping.
- Censorship Brush: Interactive pixelation brush overlay for obscuring sensitive data.

### 4. Universal Format Converter (#universal-converter)
- Supported Format Matrix: 212+ extensions (Video, Audio, Images, Documents, E-books, Spreadsheets, Archives, CAD, Fonts).
- Smart Target Derivation: Automatic match engine recommending best output target formats based on file extension.

### 5. File Metadata Editor (#metadata-editor)
- EXIF, ID3, and PDF Metadata Tag inspection and editing.
- Cover art image replacement and one-click tag stripping for privacy.

### 6. Poster Maker (#rasterbator)
- Converts single images into multi-page printable wall poster grid PDFs with precision cut guides.
